title: How to start lifting again after a break
summary: Video on returning to training after a layoff; the captions are unusable junk, so only the description is available. It says breaks cause detraining and many lifters come back the wrong way, ruining progression or getting injured, so a gradual transition is needed.
claims: Taking a break from training causes detraining
Many lifters return from a break the wrong way, which disrupts their progression or gets them injured; the comeback should be a smooth, stepwise transition
